paper.title: Streamlining Ocean Dynamics Modeling with Fourier Neural Operators: A Multiobjective Hyperparameter and Architecture Optimization Approach

methods.canonical_name: Fourier Neural Operator with DeepHyper-optimized hyperparameters
methods.architecture_note: FNO built with the Nvidia Modulus package; hyperparameters and architecture chosen by multiobjective Bayesian optimization (DeepHyper).

evidence.quote: The focus is on optimizing Fourier neural operators
We construct the model with Fourier neural operators
We use a FNO,Nθ, parameterized by learnable weights and biases

methods.canonical_name: Fourier Neural Operator, Modulus default configuration
methods.family_raw: FNO with default hyperparameters preset in Modulus

evidence.quote: We used the default hyperparameter configuration preset in Modulus as a baseline

datasets.canonical_name: SOMA idealized baroclinic wind-driven ocean simulations (100 runs, varying bolus diffusivity)

experiments.task_raw: single time-step prediction of four prognostic variables (surrogate of idealized ocean model)
experiments.target_variable: salinity, temperature, zonal and meridional velocity

loss.quote: The loss function contains two terms: the standard MSE loss and the negative ACC.
loss.note: This experiment compares pure MSE loss against MSE plus negative ACC; the latter is stored. Weighting factor alpha is a hyperparameter (Section 3.1).

epochs.quote: we trained models using the default hyperparameters provided by Modulus for 100 epochs

hardware.value: Nvidia A100 GPUs, 20 nodes x 4 GPUs (Polaris, ALCF), stated for the hyperparameter searches
hardware.quote: The searches used 20 computing nodes, with four Nvidia A100 GPUS per node, on Polaris cluster at the Argonne Leadership Computing Facility.
hardware.note: Hardware stated for the searches; hardware of the 100-epoch final trainings not stated separately.
